capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Acura: 102 kWh GM Ultium pack on all three trims (same pack as the Lyriq). Bare capacity treated as gross.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: Same 102 kWh Ultium pack as the Cadillac Lyriq, for which Wikipedia lists 102 gross / 100 usable (and Auto-data 100.4 net); ratio applied.

chemistry.notes: Estimated: Wikipedia: "102 kWh lithium-ion modular Ultium battery" (GM NCMA cells; Lyriq-V cells are NMC per EV Database). Closest enum nmc.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: Estimated from the GM Ultium platform: InsideEVs gives the Equinox EV 85 kWh Ultium pack as about 288 V nominal (80S 3P); the ZDX uses the same Ultium modules in a larger 102 kWh pack, 400 V class. No Acura page states the voltage.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Platform sibling: the Honda Prologue (GM Ultium, Google built-in) preconditions automatically via Google Maps (Wikipedia). No Acura page read for the ZDX; manual control unknown.

dc_max_kw.notes: Acura: up to 190 kW; Wikipedia agrees. Same on all trims (Charge Port).
